summary: Converts one floating-point vertex color channel into a byte. For each vertex, the base color float is added to the scaled (255.0) fourth channel float of the input vertex, the sum is truncated to an integer, and the resulting byte is written through an advancing destination pointer. A format-conversion call may rewrite the input pointer first, and an unconditional utility call runs before the vertex loop.
